patterns: Window is within_time:24h as of Thu 2026-10-08 ~12:00 GMT. The like pile is two launches an hour apart on Wed evening: Claude Haiku 5.5 (41994) and GPT-6 Intelligent UI (OpenAI 20213, Tibo 19272, sama 9278), plus Paul Graham on Amazon banning agents (7459) and Elon's one-word quote of it (9593). karpathy and swyx posted nothing in the window; simonw's Haiku pricing note sat at 216 likes.
Ranked replies above exclude the author's own thread. On the Haiku root the author's +5s follow-up ('One more thing' cache-read price cut) has 11034 likes, above Elon's 6696.

Launch-reply format that wins is a captionless image or a joke one-liner inside 15 minutes (Alisina_ai 986 at +2m, 0x0SojalSec 782 at +11m, theaidesk_ 798 at +1m, ItsPopyn 339 at +6m). The benchmark writeup (ArtificialAnlys, 176) arrived at +1h20m and finished under the meme.
The single celebrity one-liner is the only non-author reply over 1k (elonmusk, 6696) and it arrived at +1h49m, after the first-minute scrum.
Same-sentence paste shows up twice: AckAcksAck copied one line onto the source and the quote; SemDayy later copied miu21590's 'best of the three days' line onto the Tibo thread.

GPT-6 replies cluster into three formats: 'I don't have it' plus a screenshot, a Sol-vs-Luna / why-not-6.1 taxonomy nitpick (cheatyyyy 332, testingcatalog 39), and a #4oForAll / #keep4o demand posted in the first minute at low likes (stark4833, frostybaby13, DrJekyllAndMrAI).

Argument threads pay the joke first (TheElliottSmith 339 at +3m) and still pay a long contrarian take hours later (pigflyingman 262 at +50m, moenarch 233 at +3h). Elon's one-word quote drew 591 replies whose measured top likes are 33, 23, and 14.

Insider threads (Nous Series B) get short affectionate one-liners from the house at +3m and stay under 60 likes. Quote-tweets of a viral root (Anthropic's Haiku quote, 6640 likes, 241 replies) top out around 15 likes.
